verdict.rationale: Gram's docs describe an in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers before connecting a real client. You pick a server, authenticate, chat with a model that calls its tools, and inspect the resulting logs, which matches the browser-playground-before-integration story. Missing for 10: evidence of direct manual tool invocation (an inspector-style form for calling a tool with chosen arguments, not just model-mediated chat), deeper first-party documentation of the harness beyond a one-line description, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
